core_meaning.primary_meaning: Emil is a Latin-origin name meaning “Rival, eager (Latin)”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Latin word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Emil corresponds to the Latin form إِمِيل (Latin Aemilius (rival)). Its core sense is emil; rival, eager (latin). Emil is a European male given name, from Latin Aemilius. It is used among Muslims in the Caucasus and Central Asia.
